on_actions = {
	# Tokyo Express: stamp every eligible coastal state with the adopted sea regions
	# it touches (array + home region + map-icon flag). The seed effect is
	# auto-generated by _modtools/Generate-TokyoExpressRegions.py and clears its
	# arrays first, so re-running on save load is harmless.
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			# Numeric state scopes inside a scripted effect do NOT resolve from the
			# scopeless on_startup context (the set_state_flag fell through to GLOBAL,
			# observed in-game 2026-07-15). Diving into a country scope first matches
			# the proven pattern (decision complete_effects call the same style).
			JAP = {
				JAP_te_seed_regions_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
